editorialDecl.p: Diplomatic transcription of printed pages 616–653. The page image is authoritative; OCR is corrected against it. Greek verse is encoded as numbered TEI lines. Printed orthography and editorial matter are preserved; machine-generated encoding requires review.

revisionDesc.change: Initial page-level extraction using deepseek-flash; prompt dindorf-sophocles-fragments-hathi-tei-v3-2026-10-08.
Recorded 701 conservative Dindorf correspondences to Nauck or Pearson from normalized quoted-Greek similarity; unmatched fragments remain unlinked.
Split the aggregate fragment corpus into the play-level CTS work tlg0011.phthiotides; wording was not changed.

div.quote: Τραγωδία· ἡ μὲν ἡ δὲ ἠθικὴ, οἷον αἱ Φθιώτιδες καὶ ὁ Πηλεύς.

lg.l: Ὀσμῆς μου ὅπως μὴ βαρυνθήσεσθέ μου.

div.note: ἀντὶ τοῦ, ὑπὸ τῆς ὀσμῆς. Ita fere codex Monacensis: unde trimeter confieri potest, Ὀσμῆς ὅπως μοι μὴ βαρυνθήσεσθέ μου, quem quibus aliis modis restituerint viri docti ex Dobræi Aristophan. p. 183, 184. cognosci potest. Alii dubitant an hæc ex fabulæ superstitis versu 890. conficta sint, Μὴ βαρυνθῶσιν κακῇ ὀσμῇ πρὸ τοῦ δέοντος.
Joannes Damasc. in Gaisfordi append. ad Stobæum vol. IV, p. 35.

lg.l: Νέος πέφυκας· πολλὰ καὶ μαθεῖν σε δεῖ
καὶ πόλλ᾽ ἀκοῦσαι καὶ διδάσκεσθαι μακρά.

div.quote: Sed etiam ille versus non minus notus
div.note: et in tragædia Sophocli scriptus est, cui titulus Φθιώτιδες et in Bacchis Euripidi. Φθιώτιδες correctio Casauboni est. Vulgo φυλέτιδες, quod alii aliter correxerunt.

div.quote: Ἄν (συντάσσεται) παρακειμένοις καὶ ὑπερσυντελίκοις. Σ. Φθιώτισιν
Οὕτω καὶ Σοφοκλῆς τὴν Τραχινίαν Φθιώτιν εἴρηκεν.
div.note: Ad Phthiotides refert Elmsleius ad Eurip. Heraclid. v. 194. et corrigit τὴν Τραχίνα.
